# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `python -m garmin_sync.docs` from the comments in garmin_sync/schema.sql. Do not edit by hand. -->

The same descriptions are served to the model by the MCP `describe_schema` tool, together with
live fill rates, so the docs a human reads and the docs the model reads cannot drift apart.


## `health_days`

One row per calendar date (local time). Rows exist for every synced date, including days the watch was not worn, so expect fully-null rows.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | DATE | Calendar date, local time. Primary key. |
| `steps` | INTEGER | Total steps. The current date is partial until the day ends. |
| `step_goal` | INTEGER | Garmin auto-adjusting daily step goal. |
| `floors_up` | FLOAT | Floors climbed (barometric). |
| `distance_km` | FLOAT | Total distance from all movement, km. |
| `calories_total` | INTEGER | Total kcal (active + BMR). |
| `calories_active` | INTEGER | Active kcal. |
| `calories_bmr` | INTEGER | Resting metabolic kcal. Nearly constant; low information. |
| `hr_min` | INTEGER | Lowest heart rate of the day, bpm. |
| `hr_max` | INTEGER | Highest heart rate of the day, bpm. |
| `rhr` | INTEGER | Resting heart rate, bpm. Lower is generally better; a rise of 5+ bpm over baseline suggests fatigue or illness. |
| `stress_avg` | INTEGER | Average all-day stress, 0-100 (HRV-derived). 0-25 rest, 26-50 low, 51-75 medium, 76-100 high. |
| `bb_max` | INTEGER | Body Battery daily high, 0-100. Usually reached on waking. |
| `bb_min` | INTEGER | Body Battery daily low, 0-100. |
| `bb_end` | INTEGER | Most recent Body Battery value at sync time. For the current date this is a mid-day value, not end of day. |
| `moderate_activity_min` | INTEGER | Moderate intensity minutes (HR-based). Manually logged workouts contribute nothing. |
| `vigorous_activity_min` | INTEGER | Vigorous intensity minutes (HR-based). Count double toward the WHO 150 min/week target. |
| `sleep_start` | TIMESTAMP | Sleep start, UTC. Convert to local time before reasoning about bedtimes. |
| `sleep_end` | TIMESTAMP | Sleep end (wake), UTC. |
| `sleep_score` | INTEGER | Garmin sleep score, 0-100. 90+ excellent, 80-89 good, 60-79 fair, <60 poor. Attributed to the date you woke up. |
| `sleep_qualifier` | VARCHAR | Sleep score band: EXCELLENT, GOOD, FAIR, POOR. |
| `sleep_total_min` | FLOAT | Time asleep (deep + light + REM), minutes. Excludes awake time. |
| `sleep_deep_min` | FLOAT | Deep sleep, minutes. Typical adult range 60-90. |
| `sleep_light_min` | FLOAT | Light sleep, minutes. |
| `sleep_rem_min` | FLOAT | REM sleep, minutes. Typical adult range 90-120. |
| `sleep_awake_min` | FLOAT | Awake time during the sleep window, minutes. Over 30 suggests fragmented sleep. |
| `sleep_spo2_avg` | FLOAT | Average blood oxygen during sleep, %. |
| `sleep_rr_avg` | FLOAT | Average respiration rate during sleep, breaths/min. |
| `hrv_weekly_avg` | FLOAT | Rolling 7-day average of overnight HRV, ms. |
| `hrv_last_night` | FLOAT | Average overnight HRV (RMSSD), ms. Primary recovery signal; compare against the baseline band, not population norms. |
| `hrv_baseline_low` | FLOAT | Lower bound of the personal balanced HRV band, ms. |
| `hrv_baseline_high` | FLOAT | Upper bound of the personal balanced HRV band, ms. |
| `hrv_status` | VARCHAR | Garmin HRV status, e.g. BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW, NONE (not enough history). Based on the weekly average, so it lags last night's value by days. |
| `spo2_avg` | FLOAT | Average daytime blood oxygen, %. |
| `spo2_min` | FLOAT | Lowest blood oxygen reading, %. Single low readings are often sensor movement. |
| `rr_waking_avg` | FLOAT | Average waking respiration rate, breaths/min. |
| `training_readiness_score` | INTEGER | Garmin training readiness, 0-100. Computed by Garmin from sleep, HRV, recovery time and load, so it correlates with those inputs by construction. |
| `training_readiness_level` | VARCHAR | Readiness band: PRIME, HIGH, MODERATE, LOW, POOR. |
| `recovery_time_hours` | INTEGER | Garmin estimated hours until fully recovered. |
| `endurance_score` | INTEGER | Garmin endurance score, raw scale (~3500-10500). Changes over weeks, not days. |
| `fitness_age` | FLOAT | Garmin fitness age, years. Changes rarely. |
| `training_status_phrase` | VARCHAR | Garmin training status with a numeric suffix, e.g. PRODUCTIVE_3, DETRAINING, STRAINED_3. Ignores manually logged workouts. |
| `training_load_balance` | VARCHAR | Training load focus feedback, e.g. BELOW_TARGETS, AEROBIC_LOW_SHORTAGE, AEROBIC_HIGH_SHORTAGE. |
| `acwr_status` | VARCHAR | Acute:chronic workload ratio band: LOW, OPTIMAL, HIGH. |

## `health_activities`

One row per recorded or manually logged workout.

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | VARCHAR | Garmin activity id. Primary key. |
| `date` | DATE | Local start date. |
| `start_time` | TIMESTAMP | Local start time. |
| `activity_type` | VARCHAR | Garmin type key, e.g. running, mixed_martial_arts, breathwork, strength_training. |
| `duration_min` | FLOAT | Duration, minutes. |
| `distance_km` | FLOAT | Distance, km. Null for non-distance activities. |
| `avg_hr` | INTEGER | Average heart rate, bpm. Null for manually logged activities. |
| `max_hr` | INTEGER | Max heart rate, bpm. Null for manually logged activities. |
| `calories` | INTEGER | Activity kcal. For manual activities this is user-entered or estimated. |
| `training_effect_aerobic` | FLOAT | Aerobic training effect, 0-5. 0-0.9 none, 1-1.9 minor, 2-2.9 maintaining, 3-3.9 improving, 4-4.9 highly improving, 5 overreaching. |
| `training_effect_anaerobic` | FLOAT | Anaerobic training effect, 0-5. Same bands as aerobic. |
| `training_load` | FLOAT | Garmin EPOC-based load for the session. Null (not zero) for manual activities. |
| `hr_zone1_min` | FLOAT | Minutes in HR zone 1 (warm-up). |
| `hr_zone2_min` | FLOAT | Minutes in HR zone 2 (easy / aerobic base). |
| `hr_zone3_min` | FLOAT | Minutes in HR zone 3 (aerobic / tempo). |
| `hr_zone4_min` | FLOAT | Minutes in HR zone 4 (threshold). |
| `hr_zone5_min` | FLOAT | Minutes in HR zone 5 (max). |
| `avg_pace_min_km` | FLOAT | Average pace, min/km. Only meaningful for GPS activities. |
| `is_manual` | BOOLEAN | True if logged by hand in the app rather than recorded on the watch. Manual activities have no HR, zones, load or training effect, and Garmin readiness/training status do not see them. |
